text: This report is to provide the Board with an update on the status of TO Live's Digital Transformation project regarding Customer Relationship Management.

The Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Approved the Customer Relationship Management solution as part of the overall Digital Transformation project, as noted in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (February 26, 2021) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (February 26, 2021) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live remain confidential in its entirety, as it contains positions, plans, procedures, criteria, or instructions to be applied to any negotiations carried on or to be carried on by or on behalf of the City or local board.
